def get_newly_imported_items(stub_module: Module, source_module: Module
    ) ->List[ImportItem]:
    import libcst as cst

    def collect_imports(module):
        items = set()
        for stmt in module.body:
            if isinstance(stmt, cst.SimpleStatementLine):
                for s in stmt.body:
                    if isinstance(s, cst.Import):
                        if isinstance(s.names, cst.ImportStar):
                            continue
                        for alias in s.names:
                            mod_name = cst.parse_module("").code_for_node(alias.name)
                            asname = cst.parse_module("").code_for_node(alias.asname.name) if alias.asname else None
                            items.add(ImportItem(mod_name, None, asname))
                    elif isinstance(s, cst.ImportFrom):
                        if isinstance(s.names, cst.ImportStar):
                            continue
                        mod_name = module.code_for_node(s.module) if s.module else ""
                        for alias in s.names:
                            obj_name = module.code_for_node(alias.name)
                            asname = module.code_for_node(alias.asname.name) if alias.asname else None
                            items.add(ImportItem(mod_name, obj_name, asname))
        return items

    stub_imports = collect_imports(stub_module)
    source_imports = collect_imports(source_module)
    return list(stub_imports - source_imports)
